beats.text: In Uzbekistan, adult literacy is 100%. In Chad, it is 30.6%.
Uzbekistan leads all nations on the map, with universal reading and writing.
The lowest nations include Chad at 30.6%, Niger at 35.6%, Mali at 35.6%, and Burkina Faso at 41.6%.
In Asia, China has 96.7%, while India has 78.2%.
Brazil, the largest nation in South America, has 94.7%.
The metric counts people ages 15 and above who can read and write a short simple statement about everyday life.
How high is adult literacy in your country?
